svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a strip 86 mm wide and 985 mm long from 1.5 mm aluminium.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend it round the plate outline (front view), starting at the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the load side; the ends overlap 30 mm there.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend the tight curves over a 50 mm round bar; ease the long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: straights by hand. Keep the edges straight and square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet eight small aluminium angle tabs inside the band, 3 mm in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each edge: four for each plate, spread round the outline.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each tab and the plate behind it 4.5 mm for an M4 screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the band sits between the plates, flush with their edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It goes on last, after the chains are tensioned.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no gap wider than 2 mm between the band and either plate;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turn the shafts by hand: nothing rubs the band.
